In [[138 ABY]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''officer''' was stationed aboard the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Animus]]''. After the ship responded to a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress call]] from [[AG-37's freighter]] with [[Ania Solo]] aboard and picked up the freighter, the officer greeted Solo and informed her that Empress [[Marasiah Fel]] was impressed with Solo's actions in saving the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Yalta Val]] from the [[Carreras system/Legends|Carreras system]]. The Empress wished for Solo to speak to her and the other members of the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]] in a formal audience.<ref name="Legacy 6" />
